chapterInfo.content:
19
Wɔhu Onyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ abɔdeɛ mu
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ. Dawid dwom.
1 # Rom 1.20 Ɔsoro ka Nyankopɔn animuonyam,
na ewiem kyerɛ ne nsa ano adwuma.
2Da koro biara woro kyerɛ,
na anadwo biara da nimdeɛ adi.
3Ɛnyɛ ɔkasa na ɛnyɛ nsɛm a wɔteɛ.
4 # Rom 10.18 Ɔsoro susuhoma duru asase nyinaa so,
na ne nsɛm duru wiase ano;
wasi ntomadan ama owia ɔsoro hɔ.
5Na ɛfiri adi sɛ ayeforɔkunu a ɔfiri ne pia mu,
ɛde ahosɛpɛ tu mmirika sɛ ɔbrane.
6 # Dwom 104.19 N’adifire wɔ ɔsoro ano,
na ne kyini kɔduru ano hɔ,
na biribiara nkora ne ho mfiri ne hyeɛ ano.
7 # Dwom 119.50; 130 AWURADE mmara yɛ pɛ,
ɛdwodwo ɔkra.
AWURADE adanseɛ atim,
ɛma awiɛmfoɔ hunu nyansa.
8 # Dwom 12.6; 18.30; 119.105 AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ tene,
ɛma akoma tɔ yam.
AWURADE mmarahyɛ ho te,
na ɛte ani.
9AWURADE suro yɛ kronkron,
ɛgyina hɔ daa.
AWURADE atemmudeɛ yɛ nokorɛ,
ne nyinaa tene.
10 # Dwom 119.72 Ɛyɛ akɔnnɔ sene sika
ne sika amapa pii,
na ɛyɛ fremfrem sene ɛwoɔ
ne ahwedeɛ mu nsuo.
11Wɔnam so bɔ w’akoa kɔkɔ,
ɛsodie mu wɔ akatua pii.
12 # Hiob 9.3; Dwom 130.3 Hwan na ɔhunu ɔno ara ne mfomsoɔ mu?
Me bɔne a ahunta me, fa kyɛ me.
13 # Dwom 18.23 Nso bɔ w’akoa ho ban wɔ bɔne a wɔboapa yɛ ho,
na anhyɛ me so.
Ɛno na mɛdi bem,
na me ho afi amumuyɛ kɛseɛ ho.
14Ma m’anomu nsɛm nyɛ wo fɛ,
na m’akomam nkɔmmɔ nsɔ w’ani,
O AWURADE, me botan ne me gyefoɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɔsoro ka Nyankopɔn animuonyam,
na ewiem kyerɛ ne nsa ano adwuma.
Da koro biara woro kyerɛ,
na anadwo biara da nimdeɛ adi.
Ɛnyɛ ɔkasa na ɛnyɛ nsɛm a wɔteɛ.
Ɔsoro susuhoma duru asase nyinaa so,
na ne nsɛm duru wiase ano;
wasi ntomadan ama owia ɔsoro hɔ.
Na ɛfiri adi sɛ ayeforɔkunu a ɔfiri ne pia mu,
ɛde ahosɛpɛ tu mmirika sɛ ɔbrane.
N’adifire wɔ ɔsoro ano,
na ne kyini kɔduru ano hɔ,
na biribiara nkora ne ho mfiri ne hyeɛ ano.
AWURADE mmara yɛ pɛ,
ɛdwodwo ɔkra.
AWURADE adanseɛ atim,
ɛma awiɛmfoɔ hunu nyansa.
AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ tene,
ɛma akoma tɔ yam.
AWURADE mmarahyɛ ho te,
na ɛte ani.
AWURADE suro yɛ kronkron,
ɛgyina hɔ daa.
AWURADE atemmudeɛ yɛ nokorɛ,
ne nyinaa tene.
Ɛyɛ akɔnnɔ sene sika
ne sika amapa pii,
na ɛyɛ fremfrem sene ɛwoɔ
ne ahwedeɛ mu nsuo.
Wɔnam so bɔ w’akoa kɔkɔ,
ɛsodie mu wɔ akatua pii.
Hwan na ɔhunu ɔno ara ne mfomsoɔ mu?
Me bɔne a ahunta me, fa kyɛ me.
Nso bɔ w’akoa ho ban wɔ bɔne a wɔboapa yɛ ho,
na anhyɛ me so.
Ɛno na mɛdi bem,
na me ho afi amumuyɛ kɛseɛ ho.
Ma m’anomu nsɛm nyɛ wo fɛ,
na m’akomam nkɔmmɔ nsɔ w’ani,
O AWURADE, me botan ne me gyefoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
